title: Baby Shark Has More Than 16 Billion Views on YouTube

scenes.text: One kids' song has over sixteen billion views on YouTube.
It is Baby Shark Dance, from the Korean company Pinkfong.
In November 2020 it passed Despacito to become the most viewed video ever.
Before that, the first video to reach a billion views was Gangnam Style, in 2012.
Sixteen billion views is about twice the number of people on Earth.

description:
Baby Shark Dance by Pinkfong, uploaded in June 2016, has more than 16 billion views and has been the most viewed video on YouTube since November 2020.
That is about twice the number of people on Earth.
How many times have you heard it? Comment below.
first_comment: Be honest: how many times have you heard it this year?
